OpenMC

Accelerate Bench task · Transport, plasma & astronomy

OpenMC simulates multigroup neutron transport in a fuel-pin geometry.

Task version3.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

Each case runs a prescribed criticality calculation with the supplied cross sections, records tallies and writes source banks for recovery.

Correctness

Statepoint datasets and tallies must agree with the reference, and the source banks must match exactly and support checkpoint recovery.

Timing

Timing covers the complete transport process. Restart checks with the unmodified executable run separately.
